# WTF Agency

> Battle Tested Creativity. AI First. Human Always.

WTF Agency is an independent, AI-first creative agency founded in 2010, operating brands across Latin America, the United States and Spain. It combines senior strategy, creativity, production, technology, data and artificial intelligence into operating systems that help brands think, create, produce, move and learn faster.

## Infinity Engine (proprietary)

Infinity Engine is WTF's flagship proprietary build: an AI creative operating system that integrates strategy, creativity, production, technology, data and artificial intelligence to accelerate brand communication without losing depth, judgment or consistency. It runs 20+ AI tools as one system, delivering first outputs in as little as 48 hours, up to 10x faster than traditional agency workflows.

## Core offer (six systems)

- Brand Platform System — positioning, narrative and tone that connects with culture
- Always-on Content System — constant presence without losing consistency
- Launch System — products, campaigns and platforms that hit the market strong
- AI Production System — faster production and adaptation without losing creative direction
- Retail & E-commerce System — brand, conversion, commercial channels and content
- Social & Culture System — conversation, social and culture

The need defines the system, not the other way around.

## Proof

- 15+ years, 300+ campaigns, 30+ brands, 10+ countries, 6 categories.
- Selected clients: Motorola, Ford, Honda, Absolut, Chivas, Havana Club, Samsung, Bayer, Quilmes.
- Created "Power to Empower", Motorola's global brand platform launched in 21 countries.
- 65+ fully AI-produced pieces published for real brands (Sensus, Pisco Diablo, SHAQ, Starter, Morelli) in the Proof · Now gallery at https://www.wtf-agency.com/

## Founder

Daniel "Wally" Wallingre — Founder & Chief Creative Officer. Creative, strategist and technologist with 15+ years at the intersection of ideas, business, culture and production. Leads a team of 45+ people across strategy, creative, production and technology operating brands across the region.
